verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his E (Counter Strike), you win if you punish the long cooldown right after he burns it.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by one cooldown: Jax's E (Counter Strike), 18/16/14/12/10s. While it's up he can dodge your autos and turn any auto-attack trade into a stun-and-burst for him; the instant it's down he has no answer to your dash-stun-dash combo. The measured 49.6% win rate over 607 games reflects a lane that's genuinely even, decided by who tracks that cooldown better, not by raw stats.

theirWindow.when: he lands empowered Q (Leap Strike) engage
theirWindow.what: Once Empower (W, 7-3s cooldown) is loaded onto a Leap Strike (Q, 700 range, 17-5s cooldown), he closes the gap and hits bonus damage on arrival. Use E (Valor) to block the follow-up hit rather than trading autos into him.

yourWindow.when: right after he activates E (Counter Strike)
yourWindow.what: That's an 18s cooldown at rank 1, dropping only to 10s at rank 5. The moment he burns it — successfully or on a whiff — go in with Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) with no fear of the stun.

start.why: Highest win rate start (49.2% over 663 games, 90.2% pick) — the sustain and early AD offset Jax's poke range on Q.

boots.why: Best measured win rate on boots (49% over 390 games) — the ability haste shortens Q/W/E cooldowns so you can punish his E window faster than he can reset it.

core.why: Highest-win-rate core path (58.2% over 55 games) — the active dash lets you close or escape independent of your own cooldowns.
Follows Axiom Arc in the top-performing build order, adding sustained damage to skirmish trades.
Completes the core path — bleed-and-heal lets you win extended fights where his R (Relentless Assault) attack speed would otherwise wear you down.

situational.when: you want earlier burst pressure to punish his E cooldown windows before level 9
fights are running long and you need to shred through his Equipment Mastery bonus HP
their team adds magic burst you need a shield against

runes.keystoneWhy: Your Q dashes and E step let you stay on top of him through extended trades, which is exactly the sustained-fight shape that stacks Conqueror before his E timer resets.

summoners.why: Runs 49.7% win rate at 93.9% pick — Ignite closes out all-ins during his E cooldown before he can disengage with Leap Strike.

playing.title: Punish the E cooldown, not the stance
playing.detail: Never auto-attack into an active Counter Strike. Wait for him to burn it, then all-in immediately — the 18s rank-1 cooldown is your entire lane plan before level 5.

playing.title: Trade with Q, not autos, when E is up
playing.detail: Broken Wings (Q, 13s cooldown) damage doesn't get eaten by his dodge stance the way an auto-attack chain does. Use it to poke when you're unsure if E is loaded.

playing.title: Block his empowered engage with E
playing.detail: When he Leap Strikes (Q, 700 range) with Empower (W) loaded, use Valor (E) to soak the bonus-damage hit rather than eating it flat.

playing.title: Save R for the all-in, not the poke
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile's AD and range let you match his gap close and finish with Wind Slash if he tries to walk away — hold it for the fight, not for chip damage.

playing.title: Chain Ki Burst into free autos
playing.detail: Ki Burst (W, 11-7s cooldown) is your only guaranteed window to land clean autos without an E interrupt — use it the moment he commits to a Leap Strike.

playing.title: Respect his passive HP scaling late
playing.detail: Equipment Mastery gives him bonus health off his own AD/AP items, so raw one-shot burst gets less reliable by mid-game — lean on Conqueror's sustained trade damage instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the cooldown-window tactical reading is my own analysis of the kit interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Retreat with your abilities when Jax tries to close in with his Leap Strike (Q) – Counter Strike (E) combo. Harass Jax with your abilities, but keep an eye out for his (P) and Conqueror’s stacks.
